Maria (CS): Quick share — I've drafted a compact ops cheat for the Acme onboarding that focuses on three customer-facing knobs: prefix prefetch, client-side batching, and streaming fallbacks. Please review before the cs sync.

Tyler (SE): link to doc?

Maria (CS): Draft here: https://redwood.internal/docs/acme/onboard-ops-cheat (preview). Highlights in-thread: TTL guidance, batch windows, streaming timeouts, and customer note templates.

Alex (PM): Can we get the exact sample calls we want customers to run during the warmup step? PM wants reproducible steps for enablement.

Maria (CS): Sample prefetch call (keeps it tiny so customers can copy/paste):
```http
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-open-6b",
  "prompt": "[tenant_init] prime user history; write kv; respond READY",
  "max_tokens": 6
}
```
Operational knobs: prefetch TTL = 30m, concurrency cap = 4 parallel prefetch calls per tenant, jittered backoff = 250–750ms.

Tyler (SE): Batching pattern we recommend for web clients: 100ms collection window OR 8 requests, whichever hits first. Prefer route `prefer_latency` for interactive flows. Snippet for client-side collector:
```js
// client batching pseudo
let q = []
function enqueue(req){
  q.push(req)
  if(q.length >= 8) flush()
  else setTimeout(flush, 100)
}
function flush(){ /* send batch */ }
```

Jamie (SRE): Observability hooks to add: `prefetch.success`, `prefetch.fail`, `batch.flush.size`, `stream.fallback`. Required tags: tenant_id, route, model_version. Alert if `prefetch.fail` rate > 5% over 5m or if `stream.p50` > 800ms for more than 3 minutes.

Maria (CS): Fallback playbook (customer-facing): if streaming latency or errors spike, auto-switch traffic to a non-streaming variant (lower concurrency but higher stability) and send this short customer note: "We're seeing degraded streaming for your tenant; we've routed your requests to a stable mode while we investigate — no action needed on your side." (doc includes full template).

Alex (PM): Nice. Can CS + SE review by EOD so CSMs can use the one-pager tomorrow? @Jamie (SRE) can you confirm dashboards will be ready?

Jamie (SRE): I'll add a simple dashboard and two alerts: prefetch-fail-rate and stream-latency. Will verify data schema and add examples. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: Reminder: cs-sync at 16:00 UTC today (agenda includes this doc).

Maria (CS): Thanks — I'll fold the SRE details and paste sample logs below. Then I'll circulate to the CSM mailing list after the sync. :rocket:
